meta.scene_name: 掉包返程诊断（非自然完整对局）
meta.scene_rules: 生产诊断初态：清砖、1HP、敌持己包且 trap=1；assist-off；120秒；不是自然击杀证据
meta.model: H8 v35 路线 PBRS g32 raw
meta.opponent: 固定向上 / 不放泡 / 不用道具 [0,0,0]
meta.reward_source: 轨迹未采集原环境/训练 reward ledger；路线辅助 reward 单独记录，禁止相加冒充训练总 Reward

route.limitations: 诊断导出器按转移后目标分类；前后路程按该同一目标独立重算。敌方 trap 因果归属预置，非自然击杀。末 tick Phi 未归零，非训练 PBRS 账本；拓扑/安全/失效未采集。Critic 参数已交接，但本轨迹缺训练 reward ledger 及同口径反事实结果，不能计算两类 A1。

advantage.reason: 本实验 Critic 已由塑形回报训练，不能冒充原始任务 Critic；轨迹缺训练 reward ledger 与严格联合动作反事实结果
advantage.legal_actions: production legalMask.mm × TransformerModel._abilityMask; joint probabilities renormalized over legal candidates
advantage.rng_status: seeded simulator RNG restorable by draw count; counterfactual ledger equivalence not measured

meta.selection_rule: retain supplied predeclared seed, no selection; return_deviation = three increasing weighted grid distances while continuously carrying, reset on progress
